first_hour.name: Buy in the first hour
first_hour.text: Buy at the close of the first hour of trading.

day_one.name: Buy at the end of day one
day_one.text: Buy at the close of the first trading day (UTC).

dip50.name: Buy the 50% dip
dip50.text: Buy the first daily close at least 50% below the highest price since listing (days 2 to 60).

breakout.name: Buy the breakout above week one
breakout.text: Buy the first daily close above the highest price of the first 7 days (days 8 to 90).
breakout.verdict: Made money after costs, but not clearly better than random entries: could be luck.

settled.name: Buy after a month
settled.text: Buy at the close of day 30, after the listing excitement has settled.

short_first_hour.name: Sell (short) after the first hour
short_first_hour.text: Sell at the close of the first hour of trading (or sell coins you already hold, e.g. from an airdrop); buy back later. Safety exit if the price rises 30%.
short_first_hour.verdict: Beat random entries in the earlier years but not clearly in the later part of the history (after it was published, where known): the edge seems to have faded.

short_day_one.name: Sell (short) at the end of day one
short_day_one.text: Sell at the close of the first trading day (or sell coins you already hold); buy back later. Safety exit if the price rises 30%.
short_day_one.verdict: Held up: made money after costs, beat random entries by more than luck, and still did so in the later part of the history (after it was published, where known).
